purpose: Active Development and Validation draw.io tasks. Edit cases include model-visible input XML and evaluator-only preservation/change assertions. The legacy repository-visible holdout is excluded.

tasks.request: Create a draw.io diagram that recommends diagram types for system interactions and responsibility handoffs.
